_readme: Optional MCP servers the toolkit knows how to use. Copy to `.mcp.json` (gitignored) and
remove the entries you don't want. Nothing here is required — every skill/agent works
without MCP; these only make some steps more direct.
azure     — used by `incident-responder` (Log Analytics/KQL, Container Apps health).
Needs an Azure login on the developer's machine; agents still never run `az`.
mssql     — used by `db-introspector` as a READ-ONLY view of the dev Azure SQL database.
Point it at a login with SELECT-only grants (never the app's identity or the
Entra admin); there is no local database. Pick any MSSQL MCP server the team
trusts — the placeholder below is the shape, not an endorsement.
context7  — used by `docs-lookup` for version-aware library docs when available.
